title: The gate reads an unreadable state file as empty, which fails open
description:
Filed from the Stage 1 review of opum-ai/test-skills#33 (TS-24, DEC-195 (7)(a)), verdict minor 2, quoted verbatim: "test_gate_matrix.py:56-59 locks in fail-open behaviour: a corrupt quarantine file means zero violations. That is arguably a product defect, since a corrupt state file silently passes the gate. If the fail-open is intended, fine. If not, the test cements it. This is worth a TS note, not a block."

The behaviour: _load_list and _load_list_text swallow ValueError and return [], so an unreadable .test-quarantine.json, .test-probation.json or baseline file reads as empty rather than as something the gate names.

This task does NOT decide whether fail-open is intended. That is the first thing it must settle, and if the answer is not derivable from the code or an existing decision it goes to opum-doc through the leader. Whichever way it is settled, the assertion at test_gate_matrix.py:56-59 must state the decision: if fail-open is intended, it stays and should say why; if not, it is inverted to expect a named failure.

Not started, and no code changed by filing it.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The intended behaviour for an unreadable state file is decided and recorded in this task, with the reason, rather than assumed.
test_gate_matrix.py:56-59 asserts the decided behaviour: a named failure if fail-open is not intended, and the intended-reading with its reason if it is.

plan: 1. Cut fix/TS-30-fail-closed-unreadable-state-file off origin/dev and claim TS-30.
2. Replace the two swallowing loaders in gate.py with one that raises a named error carrying file, kind and parse error; tell missing from empty at the base ref with git ls-tree.
3. Convert that error into a named violation inside run() so the gate fails closed with a reason rather than crashing or passing.
4. Invert test_gate_matrix.py:56-59 and prove both directions in the same test: valid files pass, and an unparseable file of each kind fails by name.
5. Prove the mutation that restores the swallow turns the test red, with __pycache__ cleared on both arms.
6. Run the suite and the repo gate locally, open the PR, take a Stage 1 review, report.
implementationNotes: DECISION, recorded before the edit (AC0): FAIL CLOSED, ruled by opum-doc as DEC-213 on 2026-10-20T13:11:40Z and relayed by the leader, whose five terms are verbatim in the second implementation note on TS-32. An unparseable quarantine or probation file is a named violation and never passes; a MISSING file keeps its current meaning of no entries, so a fresh repository is not broken. Reason: the gate exists to stop a PR hiding tests from its own run, and a file the gate cannot parse is a state it cannot read, so reading it as empty is the one reading that always permits the action the gate exists to refuse. The baseline loader is not in this set: it already raises, which is what DEC-209 decided in words. No new test cases are added — the assertions go inside the existing parametrized test, so the test count and the baseline stay 95.
